results.notes: Brand Decathlon (decathlon.com), 1 market United Kingdom - English (EN) shown as GB (EN), AI Insights English (EN). Discovery returned "Sporting Goods" and "Outdoor Gear"; "Outdoor Gear" removed (with confirmation), C1 = "Sporting Goods". Generate Prompts enabled; generation ended in about 1 s. Prompts step = one table, intro "We generated and preselected the most relevant prompts for you. Review, edit or add more." (wizard.promptTable.intro). Ring "610 / 1000 prompts · 40 selected" (U 570 + 40). UI filter Category = Sporting Goods (menu count 30), then Type = Visibility / Competitive / Reputation: 10 rows each, all Sporting Goods, GB (EN). 40 rows, 40 ticked, no greyed row (all prompt texts #1e293b). Every C1 row shows the category badge "Sporting Goods" and its type badge; the 10 Brand Image rows show "Overview". Observation: the Category and Type menus also list a value "Other" with count 0 (wizard.promptTable.categoryOther / typeOther), see side findings.

results.title: Re-ticking a muted row keeps it again without regenerating it

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step
steps.expected: Every prompt is ticked

steps.title: When the user unticks a prompt and notes its wording
steps.expected: The row is greyed (muted) and the ring decreases by 1

steps.title: And the user ticks the same row again
steps.expected: The row is no longer greyed and the ring increases by 1

steps.title: Then the prompt is kept again without being regenerated
steps.expected: The row shows exactly the same wording, category, type and market as before

results.notes: Same wizard session as TC-001 (40 prompts, all ticked, "610 / 1000 · 40 selected"). Unticked the Sporting Goods / Visibility / GB (EN) prompt "Best Sporting Goods?": checkbox off, text greyed (#94a3b8 instead of #1e293b), ring "609 / 1000 prompts · 39 selected". Ticked it again: text back to #1e293b, ring "610 / 1000 prompts · 40 selected". Same row (same position, still 40 rows, one single "Best Sporting Goods?"), same wording, category Sporting Goods, type Visibility, market GB (EN). No network request at all during the re-tick (nothing regenerated).

results.title: The trash icon deletes a kept prompt, which is not the same as unticking

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step with 40 prompts
steps.expected: "40 selected"

steps.title: When the user unticks prompt A
steps.expected: Prompt A stays in the table, greyed; "39 selected"

steps.title: And the user clicks the trash icon of kept prompt B
steps.expected: Prompt B disappears from the table and an Undo toast is shown

steps.title: Then the trash deletes and the untick mutes
steps.expected: The table holds 39 rows: A is still listed greyed, B is gone; "38 selected"

results.notes: Same session, start "610 / 1000 · 40 selected", 40 rows. A = "Top Sporting Goods?" (C1 Visibility GB) unticked: still listed, greyed, "609 / 1000 · 39 selected". B = "Which Sporting Goods do you recommend?" (C1 Visibility GB, kept): trash icon (aria "Delete prompt") removes it at once, no confirmation dialog, toast "Prompt deleted. | Undo" (wizard.common.questionDeleted / wizard.common.undo, role=status, data-testid wizard-undo-delete-toast). Show prompts = All (menu All / Selected only / Unselected only): 39 rows, A listed unticked and greyed, B gone, "608 / 1000 prompts · 38 selected". A outlined in blue on step3_then for readability (not a defect marker).

results.title: The trash icon deletes a muted prompt, with Undo for 5 seconds

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step with a muted prompt A
steps.expected: Prompt A is greyed

steps.title: When the user clicks the trash icon of prompt A
steps.expected: Prompt A disappears and an Undo toast is shown

steps.title: And the user clicks Undo within 5 seconds
steps.expected: Prompt A is back in the table, still unticked

steps.title: When the user clicks the trash icon of prompt A again and waits more than 5 seconds
steps.expected: The toast disappears and prompt A stays deleted

results.notes: Same session. Prompt A = "Most popular Sporting Goods?" (C1 Visibility GB) unticked first: greyed, "607 / 1000 · 37 selected", 38 rows. Trash of A: row gone (37 rows), toast "Prompt deleted. | Undo"; ring unchanged (A was not counted). Undo clicked about 0.3 s later: A back at the same position, still unticked and greyed, 38 rows. Trash of A again, no Undo: the toast disappeared after about 5.1 s (measured 5069 ms), A stays deleted (37 rows, still absent 1 s later). Run note: a first attempt on another muted prompt ("Top Sporting Goods?") timed out on a wrong toast selector and that prompt stayed deleted after the toast expired; it confirms the no-Undo path too.
